title: Inquest set for December in death of man after his arrest by police in Kelowna
article: A coroner's inquest has been set for December in the death of a man in police custody last summer in Kelowna, B.C.
Colin Kenson Tremeer went into medical distress at the Kelowna RCMP detachment after his arrest on Aug. 5.
Emergency medical services responded and he was taken to Kelowna General Hospital, where he later died.
The B.C. Coroner's Service has scheduled Dec. 18 and 19 at B.C. Supreme Court in Kelowna to hear evidence on the circumstances surrounding the death.
The inquest will be presided over by coroner Tonia Grace.
The jury will be able to make recommendations aimed at preventing deaths under similar circumstances in the future.
